notes.content: There is going to be an update to bring this OVN's logo and credit sequence into align with OVN 3.  In addition, a couple of sound effects are going to be replaced.  Finally, there is going to be one new achievement.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
This update now has :

[list]
[*] One tune has been changed to something more appropriate
[*] Extra dialogue and an epilogue has been added
[*] The mountaineering section now has user-selectable difficulty (when you've completed the game at least once)
[*] A few new sound effects added
[*] Two gender-specific problems fixed
[/list]

Hopefully, though, this will fix the achievements being unlocked problem

notes.title: Last update
notes.content:
This will be the very last update for the WTC OVN, unless anything major is found.

This update changes one background (which I've never liked), and put in the new achievement system that will hopefully remove all of the initial achievement problems.

Note, however, due to how the TOTTALLYDONE achievement now works, you may have to go through the BEGOOD/EVIL/INDECISIVE routines again, if you current [u]dont [/u]have it.
